_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The Assistant shows no title, host, working directory, diffs, git graph or message actions; conversations still do. The server runs in workspace mode, with the conversation {{CONV_ID}}, whose first message is "Hello". On a fresh server the first load of a page takes a few seconds while the Assistant is created (the header title reads "Shelley" until then): wait for elements rather than reading the page right after navigating. On a phone-sized screen the drawer is off-canvas until the header's "Open tasks" button is clicked. Call "text the Assistant" has a text message "texted from a phone" arrive at the Assistant through a channel. "The git buttons" are the buttons in ".chat-workspace-actions" named exactly "Diffs" or "Git Graph". "The title" is "h1.header-title", "the header" is ".header", and "the actions" are ".header-actions"; read their boxes with getBoundingClientRect(). To "check the brand rule" W: click the button named exactly "Collapse sidebar" (in the drawer's header); ".header-left .exe-brand" should have the computed border-right-width W (that brand exists only while the sidebar is collapsed: the open drawer shows its own in ".drawer-header"); click the button named exactly "Expand sidebar" (in the page's header). Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{CONV_ID}}. 2. ".status-ready" and ".status-readout-cwd" should be visible. 3. There should be exactly 2 git buttons. 4. The title's width must be greater than 1. 5. Eval (() => { const h = document.querySelector(".header").getBoundingClientRect(); const a = document.querySelector(".header-actions").getBoundingClientRect(); sessionStorage.setItem("taskHeader", JSON.stringify({ height: h.height, right: a.x + a.width })); return "saved"; })(), expecting "saved" (the task's header). 6. Check the brand rule "1px". 7. Hover the first element with data-testid "message" containing "Hello". 8. Its button named "Copy" should be visible. 9. Navigate to /. 10. The title should have exactly the text "Assistant", and the class "sr-only" (it stays a heading for screen readers). 11. The title's width must be at most 1 (the title row shows no "Assistant"). 12. Eval this; it must return true (the header keeps its height and right-aligned actions): (() => { const saved = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem("taskHeader")); const h = document.querySelector(".header").getBoundingClientRect(); const a = document.querySelector(".header-actions").getBoundingClientRect(); return h.height === saved.height && a.x + a.width === saved.right; })(). 13. Check the brand rule "0px" (with the drawer collapsed, the logo has no title to rule off). 14. ".context-usage-label" should be visible. 15. There must be exactly 0 ".status-ready" elements and exactly 0 matching ".status-readout-cwd, .status-field-cwd". 16. The button named exactly "Terminal" in ".chat-workspace-actions" should be visible. 17. There must be exactly 0 git buttons. 18. Call "text the Assistant". 19. "The texted message" is the element with data-testid "message" containing "texted from a phone": hover it, then click it. 20. The texted message's element with data-testid "message-via-text" should be visible. 21. There must be exactly 0 ".message-action-bar" elements. 22. Set the viewport to width 390, height 800 (only width and height). 23. Click the button named exactly "More options". 24. ".overflow-toolbar-action[aria-label='Terminal']" should be visible. 25. There must be exactly 0 elements matching ".overflow-toolbar-action[aria-label='Diffs'], .overflow-toolbar-action[aria-label='Git Graph']". 26. The ".overflow-menu-item" containing "Change Language" should be visible. 27. There must be exactly 0 ".overflow-menu-item" elements containing "Directory".
